hook.convey: two same-size wholes, one cut into 4 equal parts, the other into 8 → 8 is the bigger number, yet each of its parts is smaller → which single part to pick is the question

use.hi: Socho, do ek jaise cake hain. Ek cake 4 barabar tukdon mein kata hai, doosra 8 barabar tukdon mein. Tumhe kisi ek cake se sirf ek tukda lena hai.
use.en: Picture two identical cakes. One cake is cut into 4 equal pieces, the other into 8 equal pieces. You take just one piece from one cake.

use.hi: Do ek jaisi drawing sheet hain. Ek sheet 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 8 barabar hisson mein. Tumhe kisi ek sheet ka sirf ek hissa colour karna hai.
use.en: Two identical drawing sheets. One sheet is divided into 4 equal parts, the other into 8 equal parts. You colour just one part of one sheet.

explain.convey: one bar = one whole; 4 equal parts; 1 shaded part = 1/4; bottom number = how many equal parts the whole is cut into → predict: more cuts of the same bar, one part smaller

point.hi: Yeh ek poori patti hai. Iske 4 barabar hisse hain, aur ek hissa rang wala hai, woh 1/4 hai. Neeche wala 4 batata hai ki poori patti kitne barabar hisson mein kati hai.
point.en: This is one whole bar. It has 4 equal parts, and one part is shaded; that is 1/4. The bottom number 4 tells how many equal parts the whole bar is cut into.

prompt.hi: Isi patti ko 8 barabar hisson mein kaatein, toh ek hissa pehle se bada hoga ya chhota?
prompt.en: If we cut this same bar into 8 equal parts, will one part be bigger or smaller than before?

why.hi: wahi patti 8 hisson mein bate toh har hissa chhota hota hai, 1/8 wala hissa 1/4 wale hisse ka aadha hai
why.en: when the same bar is split into 8, each part is smaller: a 1/8 part is half of a 1/4 part

simpler.hi: Patti ke 4 barabar hisse hain, aur ek rang wala hissa 1/4 hai. Neeche ka 4 batata hai ki patti kitne hisson mein bati hai.
simpler.en: The bar has 4 equal parts, and the one shaded part is 1/4. The bottom 4 tells how many parts the bar is split into.

explain.convey: same-size bar now in 8 equal parts → each earlier part split in 2 → 1 shaded part = 1/8 → set against the 1/4 part

point.hi: Ab wahi patti dekho. Iske 8 barabar hisse hain, aur ek hissa rang wala hai, woh 1/8 hai. Pehle wala har hissa ab aadha-aadha bant gaya hai.
point.en: Now look at the same bar. It has 8 equal parts, and one part is shaded; that is 1/8. Each earlier part is now cut in half.

prompt.hi: Isi size ki patti mein ek hissa kaunsa bada hai, 1/4 ya 1/8?
prompt.en: In a bar of this same size, which single part is bigger, 1/4 or 1/8?

why.hi: ek 1/4 hissa do 1/8 hisson ke barabar hai, isliye 1/4 bada hai
why.en: one 1/4 part equals two 1/8 parts, so 1/4 is bigger

simpler.hi: Wahi patti ab 8 barabar hisson mein hai, aur ek rang wala hissa 1/8 hai. Pehle ka har hissa ab do tukdon mein bant gaya.
simpler.en: The same bar is now in 8 equal parts, and the one shaded part is 1/8. Each earlier part is now split into two pieces.

explain.convey: both on one 0-to-1 line: 1/8 nearer 0, 1/4 further on → 1/8 < 1/4; same whole, more equal parts → each part smaller → bigger bottom number, smaller unit fraction

point.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak hai, aur is par 2 nishaan hain. Rekha par har fraction ki apni jagah hai: jo zero se jitna door, woh utna bada. Ek hi poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse, uska pehla nishaan zero ke utna paas.
point.en: This number line goes from 0 to 1, with 2 marks on it. Every fraction has its own place on the line: the further from zero, the bigger. The more equal parts one whole has, the closer its first mark sits to zero.

prompt.hi: Aisi hi 0 se 1 wali sankhya rekha par zero se zyada door kaunsa hoga, 1/3 ya 1/7?
prompt.en: On a 0-to-1 number line like this one, which is further from zero, 1/3 or 1/7?

why.hi: 1/3 wala hissa 1/7 wale hisse se bada hai, toh 1/3 zero se zyada door rukta hai
why.en: a 1/3 part is bigger than a 1/7 part, so 1/3 stops further from zero

simpler.hi: Line par jo zero se zyada door, woh bada. Ek hi poore ke jitne zyada hisse, pehla nishaan zero ke utna paas.
simpler.en: On the line, the one further from zero is bigger. The more parts one whole has, the closer the first mark is to zero.

problem.hi: Do ek jaise chocolate bar hain. Rahul ko ek bar ka 1/6 milta hai, Sana ko doosre bar ka 1/3. Kise bada tukda milta hai?
problem.en: There are two identical chocolate bars. Rahul gets 1/6 of one bar, Sana gets 1/3 of the other. Who gets the bigger piece?

givens.hi: do ek jaise bar hain, Rahul ko 1/6 aur Sana ko 1/3 milta hai
givens.en: two identical bars, Rahul gets 1/6 and Sana gets 1/3

do.hi: Dono bhinnon ka upar ka number dekho

steps.result: dono mein 1, yaani dono ko ek-ek tukda

why.en: the top number tells how many pieces each got, so now only the size of a piece matters

simpler.hi: 1/6 aur 1/3 dono mein upar 1 hai. Matlab dono ko ek-ek tukda mila, ab sirf tukde ka size dekhna hai.
simpler.en: Both 1/6 and 1/3 have 1 on top. So each got one piece, and now only the piece size matters.

do.hi: Ab dono ke tukde ka size likho
do.en: Now write the size of each one's piece

steps.result: Rahul ka tukda 1/6, Sana ka tukda 1/3

why.hi: Rahul ka bar 6 barabar hisson mein kata hai aur Sana ka sirf 3 barabar hisson mein

simpler.hi: Rahul ka tukda 1/6 hai aur Sana ka 1/3. Jis bar ke kam hisse bane, uska har hissa bada hota hai.
simpler.en: Rahul's piece is 1/6 and Sana's is 1/3. The bar made into fewer parts has bigger parts.

prompt.hi: Rahul ka tukda 1/6 hai, Sana ka tukda 1/3. Toh bada tukda kise mila, Rahul ko ya Sana ko?
prompt.en: Rahul's piece is 1/6, Sana's piece is 1/3. So who got the bigger piece, Rahul or Sana?

simpler.hi: Dono bar ek jaise hain. Jiska bar kam hisson mein bata hai, uska tukda bada hai.
simpler.en: Both bars are the same size. Whoever's bar is split into fewer parts has the bigger piece.

answer.hi: Sana ko bada tukda mila, 1/3 wala
answer.en: Sana got the bigger piece, the 1/3 one

why.hi: ek hi bar ke jitne zyada hisse, har hissa utna chhota, isliye 6 bada hote hue bhi 1/6 chhota tukda hai
why.en: the more parts the same bar has, the smaller each part, so though 6 is bigger, 1/6 is the smaller piece

prompt.hi: Do ek jaisi roti hain. Ek 10 barabar tukdon mein kati hai, doosri 5 barabar tukdon mein. Kaunsa ek tukda bada hai, 1/10 ya 1/5?

accept: the piece from the roti cut into 5

why.hi: 5 tukdon wali roti ka har 1/5 tukda 10 tukdon wali roti ke 1/10 tukde se do guna hai
why.en: each 1/5 piece of the roti cut into 5 is twice a 1/10 piece of the roti cut into 10

simpler.hi: Dono roti ek jaisi hain. Jis roti ke kam tukde hain, uska har tukda bada hota hai.
simpler.en: Both rotis are the same size. The roti with fewer pieces has bigger pieces.

prompt.hi: Ek hi poore ke yeh teen bhinn chhote se bade ke kram mein lagao: 1/3, 1/12, 1/6.
prompt.en: Put these three fractions of the same whole in order from smallest to biggest: 1/3, 1/12, 1/6.

why.hi: ek hi poore ke 1/12 hisse sabse chhote hote hain, phir 1/6, aur 1/3 sabse bade
why.en: of one whole, 1/12 parts are the smallest, then 1/6, and 1/3 the biggest

simpler.hi: Ek hi poore mein neeche ka number jitna bada, hissa utna chhota. Sabse bade neeche wale number se shuru karo.
simpler.en: In the same whole, the bigger the bottom number, the smaller the part. Start with the biggest bottom number.

prompt.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai. 0 ke baad pehle nishaan par question mark laga hai. Woh question mark wala nishaan 1/8 se bada hai ya chhota?
prompt.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 4 equal parts. The first mark after 0 has a question mark on it. Is that marked point bigger or smaller than 1/8?

why.hi: question mark wala nishaan 1/4 hai, aur 1/4 do 1/8 ke barabar hai, isliye woh 1/8 se bada hai
why.en: the question-mark point is 1/4, and 1/4 equals two 1/8s, so it is bigger than 1/8

simpler.hi: Yeh line 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Jitne kam hisse, utna bada har hissa.
simpler.en: This line is split into 4 equal parts. The fewer the parts, the bigger each part.

predict before cutting: 3 vs 6 pieces of one laddoo → rule used without a picture
three unit fractions to order (1/2, 1/10, 1/5) → bottom numbers read in reverse

say.hi: Is patti ke 8 barabar hisse hain, aur rang wale 2 hisse milkar theek ek 1/4 jitne lambe hain. Toh 8 bada number hai, par 1/8 chhota hissa hai.
say.en: This bar has 8 equal parts, and the 2 shaded parts together are exactly as long as one 1/4. So 8 is the bigger number, but 1/8 is the smaller part.

simpler.hi: Patti ke 8 barabar hisse hain. 2 chhote hisse milkar ek 1/4 ke barabar hain. Isliye 1/8 chhota hissa hai.
simpler.en: The bar has 8 equal parts. 2 small parts together equal one 1/4. So 1/8 is the smaller part.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaisi bottle: Ravi ne ek ka 1/7 nikala, {friend} ne doosri ka 1/9. Zyada kisne nikala, Ravi ne ya {friend} ne?
prompt.en: Two identical bottles: Ravi pours out 1/7 of one, {friend} 1/9 of the other. Who poured out more, Ravi or {friend}?

why.hi: ek jaisi bottle ka 1/7 hissa 1/9 hisse se bada hai, isliye Ravi ne zyada nikala
why.en: of identical bottles, 1/7 is more than 1/9, so Ravi poured out more

simpler.hi: Dono bottle ek jaisi hain. 1/7 aur 1/9 mein jiska neeche ka number chhota hai, uska hissa bada hai.
simpler.en: Both bottles are the same size. Of 1/7 and 1/9, the one with the smaller bottom number is the bigger part.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab tak har baar ek hi tukda tha, jaise 1/4 aur 1/8, toh tukde ka size faisla karta tha. Ab dekhenge ki neeche ka number same ho, jaise 3/7 aur 5/7, tab kaise tulna karte hain.
bridgeToNext.en: So far it was always one piece, like 1/4 and 1/8, so the piece size decided. Next we see how to compare when the bottom number is the same, like 3/7 and 5/7.

hook.convey: two same-size wholes, each cut into 7 equal parts; one person takes 3 parts of one, another takes 5 parts of the other → same-size parts, so who has more is settled by the top number alone

use.hi: Do ek jaise cake hain, dono 7 barabar tukdon mein kate hain. {friend} ne ek cake ke 3 tukde khaaye, aur Sohan ne doosre cake ke 5 tukde.
use.en: Two identical cakes, both cut into 7 equal pieces. {friend} ate 3 pieces of one cake, and Sohan ate 5 pieces of the other.

use.hi: Do ek jaise garden hain, dono 7 barabar kyariyon mein bante hain. Ritu apne garden ki 3 kyariyon mein flower lagati hai, Vikram apne garden ki 5 kyariyon mein.
use.en: Two identical gardens, each divided into 7 equal beds. Ritu plants flowers in 3 beds of her garden, Vikram in 5 beds of his.

explain.convey: bar in 7 equal parts → each part 1/7; 3 shaded = 3/7 = three 1/7 parts; top number = how many of those equal parts are taken

point.hi: Yeh patti 7 barabar hisson mein kati hai, toh har hissa 1/7 hai. Isme 3 hisse rang wale hain, yeh 3/7 hai. Upar wala 3 batata hai ki aise kitne hisse liye gaye.
point.en: This bar is cut into 7 equal parts, so each part is 1/7. 3 parts are shaded; that is 3/7. The top number 3 tells how many such parts are taken.

prompt.hi: Isi patti ke 5 hisse rang dein, toh woh kaunsa bhinn hoga?
prompt.en: If we shade 5 parts of this same bar, which fraction will that be?

why.hi: patti ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 5 rang wale hain, yaani 5/7
why.en: the bar has 7 equal parts and 5 of them are shaded, which is 5/7

simpler.hi: Patti ke 7 barabar hisse hain, har hissa 1/7. 3 hisse rang wale hain, toh 3/7, kyunki upar ka 3 rang wale hisse ginta hai.
simpler.en: The bar has 7 equal parts, each 1/7. 3 parts are shaded, so it is 3/7, because the top 3 counts the shaded parts.

explain.convey: same bar, same 1/7 parts; 5 shaded = 5/7 → part size unchanged, only the count changes → the 'both are sevenths, so equal' belief tested

point.hi: Wahi patti, wahi 1/7 wale hisse. Ab 5 hisse rang wale hain, yeh 5/7 hai. Yahan bhi hisson ka size same hai, bas rang wale hisse zyada hain.
point.en: The same bar, the same 1/7 parts. Now 5 parts are shaded; that is 5/7. The parts are the same size; only more of them are shaded.

prompt.hi: Rohan kehta hai ki 3/7 aur 5/7 barabar hain, kyunki dono sevenths hain. Kya woh sahi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Rohan says 3/7 and 5/7 are equal because both are sevenths. Is he right, yes or no?

why.hi: dono mein hisse 1/7 ke hain, par 5/7 mein 5 hisse hain aur 3/7 mein sirf 3
why.en: both have 1/7 parts, but 5/7 has 5 of them and 3/7 only 3

simpler.hi: Yeh wahi 1/7 wale hisse hain, sab ek size ke. Ab 5 hisse rang wale hain, toh 5/7.
simpler.en: These are the same 1/7 parts, all one size. Now 5 parts are shaded, so it is 5/7.

explain.convey: one 0-to-1 line in sevenths: 3/7 = 3 parts from 0, 5/7 = 5 parts from 0 → further from 0 = bigger; same bottom number → compare top numbers

point.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak sevenths mein bati hai, aur is par 2 nishaan hain, 3/7 aur 5/7. 5/7 zero se zyada door hai. Jab neeche ka number same ho, toh upar ka number dekho. Jo zero se zyada door, woh bada.
point.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is cut into sevenths, with 2 marks on it, 3/7 and 5/7. 5/7 is further from zero. With the same bottom number, look at the top number. The one further from zero is bigger.

prompt.hi: Ab sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak 5 barabar hisson mein bati ho. Zero se zyada door kaunsa hoga, 2/5 ya 4/5?
prompt.en: Now the number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 5 equal parts. Which is further from zero, 2/5 or 4/5?

why.hi: dono mein hisse 1/5 ke hain, aur 4/5 mein 4 hisse hain, 2/5 ke 2 hisson se zyada
why.en: both have 1/5 parts, and 4/5 has 4 of them, more than the 2 of 2/5

simpler.hi: Neeche ka number same ho toh hisse ek size ke hain. Phir jiska upar ka number bada, woh zero se zyada door hai.
simpler.en: When the bottom number is the same, the parts are one size. Then the one with the bigger top number is further from zero.

explain.convey: rule holds only with matching bottom numbers → same-size pieces → more pieces = more; bottom numbers differ → piece sizes differ → the count of pieces alone decides nothing

point.hi: Baayein taraf neeche ka number same hai, toh same size ke hisse, aur zyada hisse matlab zyada. Daayein taraf neeche ke number alag hain, toh alag size ke hisse, aur sirf hisse ginne se faisla nahi hota.
point.en: On the left, same bottom number, so same-size pieces, and more pieces = more. On the right, different bottom numbers, so different-size pieces, and pieces alone do not decide.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise bar hain: ek ka 2/3, doosre ka 3/10. 3/10 mein zyada hisse hain. Kaunsa bada hai, 2/3 ya 3/10?
prompt.en: Two identical bars: 2/3 of one, 3/10 of the other. 3/10 has more pieces. Which is bigger, 2/3 or 3/10?

why.hi: 2/3 aadhe se zyada hai, par 3/10 aadhe yaani 5/10 se bhi kam hai
why.en: 2/3 is more than a half, but 3/10 is less than a half, 5/10

simpler.hi: Neeche ke number same hon, toh bas hisse gin lo. Neeche ke number alag hon, toh hisson ka size bhi dekhna padta hai.
simpler.en: If the bottom numbers are the same, just count the parts. If they are different, you must also look at the size of the parts.

why.en: both cakes are the same size and both are in 8 equal pieces

simpler.hi: 5/8 aur 3/8 dono mein neeche 8 hai. Toh dono cake ke tukde ek hi size ke hain, har tukda 1/8.
simpler.en: Both 5/8 and 3/8 have 8 at the bottom. So the pieces of both cakes are the same size, each 1/8.

do.en: Now look at the top number

steps.result: Meena ke 1/8 wale 5 tukde, Raju ke 3 tukde

simpler.hi: Sab tukde ek size ke hain. Jisne kam tukde khaye, usne kam cake khaya.

prompt.hi: Meena ne ek cake ka 2/6 khaya aur uske bhai ne usi cake ka 4/6. Zyada kisne khaya: Meena ne ya uske bhai ne, ya dono ne barabar?
prompt.en: Meena ate 2/6 of a cake and her brother ate 4/6 of the same cake. Who ate more: Meena or her brother, or did they eat the same?

why.hi: dono ke tukde 1/6 ke hain, aur bhai ka 4/6 Meena ke 2/6 se zyada hai
why.en: both have 1/6 pieces, and her brother's 4/6 is more than Meena's 2/6

simpler.hi: Dono bhinn usi cake ke hain aur neeche ka number same hai. Toh sirf upar ke number dekho.
simpler.en: Both fractions are of the same cake and have the same bottom number. So just look at the top numbers.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise cake hain. Ben ka cake 4 barabar tukdon mein kata hai aur Ben ne 2 tukde liye. {friend} ka cake 12 barabar tukdon mein kata hai aur {friend} ne 3 tukde liye. {friend} ka kehna hai ki zyada cake uske paas hai, kyunki 3 tukde 2 se zyada hain. Zyada cake kiske paas hai, Ben ke ya {friend} ke?

why.hi: Ben ka 2/4 aadha cake hai, par 3/12 sirf 1/4 cake hai, isliye Ben ke paas zyada hai
why.en: Ben's 2/4 is half the cake, but 3/12 is only 1/4 of the cake, so Ben has more

simpler.hi: 12 tukdon wale cake ke 3 tukde milkar 4 tukdon wale cake ke ek tukde jitne hain. Ab dono ke hisson ki tulna karo.
simpler.en: 3 pieces of the cake in 12 pieces together equal one piece of the cake in 4 pieces. Now compare the two shares.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise cake hain: ek ke 4 barabar tukdon mein se 3, doosre ke 6 barabar tukdon mein se 5. Dono mein poore cake se ek tukda kam hai. Kaunsa bada hai, 3/4 ya 5/6?
prompt.en: Two identical cakes: 3 of 4 equal pieces of one, 5 of 6 equal pieces of the other. Both are one piece short of the whole cake. Which is bigger, 3/4 or 5/6?

why.hi: 5/6 mein 1/6 kam hai aur 3/4 mein 1/4 kam, aur 1/6 ka gap 1/4 ke gap se chhota hai
why.en: 5/6 is short by 1/6 and 3/4 by 1/4, and a 1/6 gap is smaller than a 1/4 gap

simpler.hi: Dono mein poore cake se ek tukda kam hai. Jo tukda kam hai, woh jitna chhota, bacha hua hissa utna bada.
simpler.en: Both are one piece short of the whole cake. The smaller the missing piece, the bigger the share.

simpler.en: The parts of 2/9 and 7/9 are the same size. 7/9 has more parts, so it is further from zero and bigger.

prompt.hi: Ek ribbon ke 10 barabar tukde hain. {friend} ne 3 tukde liye, Gopi ne 7. Zyada kiske paas hai, {friend} ke ya Gopi ke?
prompt.en: A ribbon has 10 equal pieces. {friend} takes 3 pieces, Gopi takes 7. Who has more, {friend} or Gopi?

why.hi: saare tukde ribbon ke 1/10 hain, aur Gopi ka 7/10, 3/10 se zyada hai
why.en: all the pieces are tenths of the ribbon, and Gopi's 7/10 is more than 3/10

simpler.hi: Ribbon ke sab tukde ek size ke hain. Toh jiske paas zyada tukde, uske paas zyada ribbon.
simpler.en: All the ribbon pieces are the same size. So whoever has more pieces has more ribbon.

remediation.move: both shares on one 0-to-1 line in ninths: 2/9 = 2 ninths, 1/3 = 3 ninths → 1 third-piece reaches further than 2 ninth-pieces → the count of pieces decides only when the pieces are the same size, i.e. same bottom number

say.hi: Ek 1/3 teen 1/9 ke barabar hai, isliye sankhya rekha par 1/3 teen chhote hisson tak jaata hai, aur 2/9 sirf do tak. Hisse tabhi gino jab unka size same ho.
say.en: One 1/3 equals three 1/9, so on the number line 1/3 reaches three small parts, and 2/9 only two. Count pieces only when they are the same size.

simpler.hi: Ek 1/3 teen 1/9 ke barabar hai, par 2/9 sirf do 1/9 hai. Hisse tabhi gino jab unka size same ho.
simpler.en: One 1/3 equals three 1/9, but 2/9 is only two 1/9. Count pieces only when they are the same size.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaisi patti: ek ke 5 barabar hisse, doosri ke 10. Kaun zyada hai, 3/5 ya 4/10?
prompt.en: Two identical strips, one cut into 5 equal parts, one into 10. Which is more, 3/5 or 4/10?

accept: 3 pieces of the bar cut into 5

why.hi: 3/5 utna hai jitna 6/10, aur 6/10, 4/10 se zyada hai
why.en: 3/5 is as much as 6/10, and 6/10 is more than 4/10

simpler.hi: 10 hisson wala ek tukda, 5 hisson wale ek tukde ka aadha hai. Toh 4/10 ko 5 hisson wale tukdon mein badal kar dekho.
simpler.en: One piece out of 10 is half of one piece out of 5. So turn 4/10 into pieces out of 5 and compare.

remediation.move: one 0-to-1 line in tenths: 1/2 = 5 tenths, gap to 1 = 5 tenths; 4/5 = 8 tenths, gap to 1 = 2 tenths → both one piece short, but the missing pieces differ in size → smaller gap = closer to the whole = bigger

say.hi: Sankhya rekha ke 2 nishaan dekho: 1/2 utna hai jitna 5/10, aur 4/5 utna jitna 8/10, toh 4/5 ka gap chhota hai. Dono mein ek tukda kam hai, par jiska gap chhota, woh 1 ke zyada paas hai aur wahi bada hai.
say.en: Look at the 2 marks on the number line: 1/2 is as much as 5/10, and 4/5 as much as 8/10, so 4/5 has the smaller gap. Both are one piece short, but the one with the smaller gap is closer to 1 and bigger.

simpler.hi: 4/5 utna hai jitna 8/10, aur 1/2 utna jitna 5/10. 4/5 ka gap chhota hai, isliye woh 1 ke paas hai aur bada hai.
simpler.en: 4/5 is as much as 8/10, and 1/2 as much as 5/10. 4/5 has the smaller gap, so it is closer to 1 and bigger.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaisi patti: ek ke 8 barabar hisse, doosri ke 10. Dono mein ek hissa kam. Kaunsa bada, 7/8 ya 9/10?
prompt.en: Two identical strips, one in 8 equal parts, one in 10. Each is one part short. Which is bigger, 7/8 or 9/10?

why.hi: 9/10 mein 1/10 kam hai aur 7/8 mein 1/8 kam, aur 1/10 ka gap 1/8 ke gap se chhota hai
why.en: 9/10 is short by 1/10 and 7/8 by 1/8, and a 1/10 gap is smaller than a 1/8 gap

simpler.hi: Dono mein ek tukda kam hai. 8 hisson wala tukda 10 hisson wale tukde se bada hai, toh jismein bada tukda kam hai, uska hissa chhota.
simpler.en: Both are one piece short. A piece out of 8 is bigger than a piece out of 10, so the one missing the bigger piece is smaller.

bridgeToNext.hi: Jab neeche ka number same tha, jaise 3/7 aur 5/7, tab upar wala number dekha. Ab ulta dekhenge, jab upar ka number same ho, jaise 3/5 aur 3/8.
bridgeToNext.en: When the bottom number was the same, like 3/7 and 5/7, we looked at the top number. Next we look at the opposite case, when the top number is the same, like 3/5 and 3/8.

hook.convey: two same-length wholes, one in 5 equal parts, the other in 8; 3 parts taken from each → same count, yet the lengths differ → equal only if the parts match → part size decides

use.hi: Ek video game mein do health bar ek jaise lambe hain. Ek 5 barabar khaanon mein bata hai, doosra 8 barabar khaanon mein. Dono mein 3-3 khaane bhare hain.
use.en: In a video game, two health bars are the same length. One is split into 5 equal blocks, the other into 8 equal blocks. Each has 3 blocks filled.

use.hi: Do ek jaise cake hain. Ek 5 barabar tukdon mein kata hai, doosra 8 barabar tukdon mein. Tumhe kisi ek cake se 3 tukde milenge.
use.en: Two identical cakes. One is cut into 5 equal pieces, the other into 8 equal pieces. You get 3 pieces from one cake.

explain.convey: bar in 5 equal parts, 3 shaded = 3/5; each part 1/5 → predict the fraction for 3 parts of a same-size bar in 8

point.hi: Yeh patti 5 barabar hisson mein kati hai, toh har hissa 1/5 hai. Isme 3 hisse rang wale hain, yeh 3/5 hai.
point.en: This bar is cut into 5 equal parts, so each part is 1/5. 3 parts are shaded; that is 3/5.

prompt.hi: Ab isi size ki ek patti ko 8 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 3 hisse rango. Woh kaunsa bhinn hoga?
prompt.en: Now cut a bar of the same size into 8 equal parts and shade 3. Which fraction is that?

why.hi: patti ke 8 barabar hisson mein se 3 rang wale hain, yaani 3/8
why.en: the bar has 8 equal parts and 3 of them are shaded, which is 3/8

simpler.hi: Patti ke 5 barabar hisse hain, har hissa 1/5. Isme 3 hisse rang wale hain, toh yeh 3/5 hai.
simpler.en: The bar has 5 equal parts, each 1/5. 3 parts are shaded, so it is 3/5.

explain.convey: same-size bar in 8 equal parts, 3 shaded = 3/8; same count 3, but each 1/8 part shorter → shading stops sooner → the 'both are 3 pieces, so equal' belief tested

point.hi: Wahi size ki patti, ab 8 barabar hisson mein kati hai, toh har hissa 1/8 hai. Ismein bhi 3 hisse rang wale hain, yeh 3/8 hai.
point.en: A bar of the same size, now cut into 8 equal parts, so each part is 1/8. It also has 3 shaded parts; that is 3/8.

prompt.hi: Tanvi kehti hai ki 3/5 aur 3/8 barabar hain, kyunki dono mein 3 hisse hain. Kya woh sahi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Tanvi says 3/5 and 3/8 are equal because both have 3 parts. Is she right, yes or no?

why.hi: dono mein 3 hisse hain, par 1/5 wale hisse 1/8 wale hisson se bade hain, isliye 3/5 zyada hai
why.en: both have 3 parts, but fifths are bigger than eighths, so 3/5 is more than 3/8

simpler.hi: Isi size ki patti ab 8 barabar hisson mein hai, har hissa 1/8. Isme bhi 3 hisse rang wale hain, toh 3/8.
simpler.en: A bar of the same size is now in 8 equal parts, each 1/8. It also has 3 shaded parts, so it is 3/8.

explain.convey: same top → same count → piece size decides; 1/5 > 1/8 (unit-fraction rule) → 3/5 > 3/8; bigger bottom → smaller fraction, only when the tops match

point.hi: Baayein 3/5 hai: 3 hisse, har hissa 1/5, bade hisse. Daayein 3/8 hai: 3 hisse, har hissa 1/8, chhote hisse. Ginti same hai, toh hisse ka size faisla karta hai. 1/5 bada hai 1/8 se, isliye 3/5 > 3/8.
point.en: On the left, 3/5: 3 pieces, each piece 1/5, bigger pieces. On the right, 3/8: 3 pieces, each piece 1/8, smaller pieces. The count is the same, so the piece size decides. 1/5 is bigger than 1/8, so 3/5 > 3/8.

prompt.hi: Ab do aisi hi patti lo: ek mein 1/9 wale 2 hisse, doosri mein 1/5 wale 2 hisse. Kaunsa zyada hai, 2/9 ya 2/5?
prompt.en: Now take two bars like these: two 1/9 parts in one, two 1/5 parts in the other. Which is more, 2/9 or 2/5?

why.hi: dono mein 2 hisse hain, aur 1/5 wala hissa 1/9 wale hisse se bada hai, isliye 2/5 zyada hai
why.en: both have 2 parts, and a fifth is bigger than a ninth, so 2/5 is more than 2/9

simpler.hi: Dono mein 3 hisse hain, toh ginti same hai. Ab hisse ka size dekho: 1/5 wala hissa 1/8 wale se bada hai.
simpler.en: Both have 3 parts, so the count is the same. Now look at part size: a 1/5 part is bigger than a 1/8 part.

explain.convey: 3/4 vs 3/8 on one line in eighths: a quarter = 2 eighths → 3/4 = 6 eighths → twice as far from 0 as 3/8 → transfer: 2/4 = 4 eighths, so 2/4 vs 5/8 on the same line

point.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. 3/8 teen hisson par rukta hai. Ek 1/4 do 1/8 ke barabar hai, isliye 3/4 chhe hisson tak jaata hai.
point.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 8 equal parts. 3/8 stops at 3 parts. One 1/4 equals two 1/8, so 3/4 goes up to 6 parts.

prompt.hi: Isi sankhya rekha par socho. Kaunsa bada hai, 2/4 ya 5/8?
prompt.en: Think on this same number line. Which is bigger, 2/4 or 5/8?

why.hi: 2/4 utna hai jitna 4/8, aur 5/8 usse ek hissa aage hai
why.en: 2/4 is as much as 4/8, and 5/8 is one part beyond it

simpler.hi: Ek 1/4 do 1/8 ke barabar hai. Isliye 3/4 line par 6 hisson tak jaata hai, aur 3/8 sirf 3 tak.
simpler.en: One 1/4 equals two 1/8. So 3/4 goes up to 6 parts on the line, and 3/8 only to 3.

problem.hi: Do ek jaise chocolate bar hain. Farhan ek bar ka 2/5 khaata hai, Isha doosre bar ka 2/3. Kisne zyada khaya?
problem.en: There are two identical chocolate bars. Farhan eats 2/5 of one bar, Isha eats 2/3 of the other. Who ate more?

givens.hi: do ek jaise bar hain, Farhan 2/5 aur Isha 2/3 khaate hain
givens.en: two identical bars, Farhan eats 2/5 and Isha 2/3

do.hi: Dono bhinnon ka upar ka number dekho
do.en: Look at the top number of both fractions

steps.result: dono mein 2, yaani dono ne 2-2 tukde khaye

why.hi: upar ka number tukdon ki ginti batata hai, toh ab sirf tukde ka size dekhna hai
why.en: the top number tells the count of pieces, so now only the size of a piece matters

simpler.hi: 2/5 aur 2/3 dono mein upar 2 hai. Matlab dono ne 2-2 tukde khaye, ab sirf tukde ka size dekhna hai.
simpler.en: Both 2/5 and 2/3 have 2 on top. So each ate 2 pieces, and now only the piece size matters.

do.hi: Ab har tukde ka size likho
do.en: Now write the size of each piece

steps.result: Farhan ka har tukda 1/5, Isha ka har tukda 1/3

why.hi: Farhan ka bar 5 barabar hisson mein kata hai aur Isha ka usi size ka bar 3 barabar hisson mein
why.en: Farhan's bar is cut into 5 equal parts and Isha's bar of the same size into 3 equal parts

simpler.hi: Farhan ka har tukda 1/5 hai aur Isha ka har tukda 1/3. Jis bar ke kam hisse bane, uska har tukda bada hota hai.
simpler.en: Each of Farhan's pieces is 1/5 and each of Isha's is 1/3. The bar made into fewer parts has bigger pieces.

prompt.hi: Isha ne 2/3 khaya, yaani 1/3 wale 2 tukde; Farhan ne 2/5, yaani 1/5 wale 2 tukde. Toh zyada kisne khaya, Farhan ne ya Isha ne?
prompt.en: Isha's 2 pieces are thirds, Farhan's 2 pieces are fifths. So who ate more, Farhan or Isha?

simpler.hi: Dono ke 2-2 tukde hain. 1/3 wala tukda 1/5 wale tukde se bada hai, toh jiske tukde bade, usne zyada khaya.
simpler.en: Each has 2 pieces. A 1/3 piece is bigger than a 1/5 piece, so whoever has the bigger pieces ate more.

why.hi: dono ke tukde 2-2 hain, aur 1/3 wale tukde 1/5 wale tukdon se bade hain
why.en: both have 2 pieces, and the 1/3 pieces are bigger than the 1/5 pieces

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise chocolate bar hain: ek ke 7 barabar tukdon mein se 4, doosre ke 9 barabar tukdon mein se 4. Kaunsa zyada hai, 4/7 ya 4/9?
prompt.en: Two identical chocolate bars: 4 of 7 equal pieces of one, 4 of 9 equal pieces of the other. Which is more, 4/7 or 4/9?

why.hi: dono mein 4 tukde hain, aur 1/7 wala tukda 1/9 wale tukde se bada hai, isliye 4/7 zyada hai
why.en: both are 4 pieces, and a seventh is bigger than a ninth, so 4/7 is more than 4/9

simpler.hi: Dono mein 4 tukde hain. Toh dekho kiske tukde bade hain, 7 hisson wale ya 9 hisson wale.
simpler.en: Both have 4 pieces. So see whose pieces are bigger, the ones out of 7 or out of 9.

prompt.hi: Anjali aur Gopi ke paas ek jaisi ribbon ki patti hai. Anjali apni patti ke 12 barabar tukdon mein se 5 kaatti hai, Gopi apni patti ke 6 barabar tukdon mein se 5. Lamba tukda kisne kaata, Anjali ne ya Gopi ne?
prompt.en: Anjali and Gopi have same-size ribbon strips. Anjali cuts off 5 of 12 equal pieces of her strip, and Gopi cuts off 5 of 6 equal pieces of his. Who cuts off the longer piece, Anjali or Gopi?

why.hi: dono ne 5 tukde kaate, Gopi ka 1/6 tukda Anjali ke 1/12 se do guna hai, isliye Gopi ka 5/6 lamba
why.en: both cut 5 pieces, and Gopi's 1/6 piece is twice Anjali's 1/12, so Gopi's 5/6 is longer than her 5/12

simpler.hi: Dono ke paas 5-5 tukde hain. 6 hisson wala tukda 12 hisson wale tukde se bada hota hai.
simpler.en: Both have 5 pieces. A piece out of 6 is bigger than a piece out of 12.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise pizza hain: ek ke 5 barabar slice mein se 4, doosre ke 6 barabar slice mein se 5. Dono mein poore pizza se ek slice kam hai. Kaunsa bada hai, 4/5 ya 5/6?
prompt.en: Two identical pizzas: 4 of 5 equal slices of one, 5 of 6 equal slices of the other. Both are one slice short of the whole pizza. Which is bigger, 4/5 or 5/6?

why.hi: 5/6 mein 1/6 kam hai aur 4/5 mein 1/5 kam, aur 1/6 ka gap 1/5 ke gap se chhota hai
why.en: 5/6 is short by 1/6 and 4/5 by 1/5, and a 1/6 gap is smaller than a 1/5 gap

simpler.hi: Dono mein ek slice kam hai. Jo slice kam hai, woh jitni chhoti, bacha hua hissa utna bada.
simpler.en: Both are one slice short. The smaller the missing slice, the bigger the share.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise bar: ek ke 5 barabar tukdon mein se 3 rang wale, doosre ke 10 mein se 3. Zyada rang kismein, 3/5 ya 3/10?

why.hi: dono mein 3 tukde hain, aur 1/5 wala tukda 1/10 wale tukde se do guna hai, isliye 3/5 zyada hai
why.en: both have 3 pieces, and a fifth is twice a tenth, so 3/5 is more than 3/10

simpler.hi: Dono mein 3 tukde rang wale hain. 5 hisson wala tukda 10 hisson wale tukde se bada hai.
simpler.en: Both have 3 shaded pieces. A piece out of 5 is bigger than a piece out of 10.

remediation.move: two same-size ribbons on one 0-to-1 line in eighths: a quarter = 2 eighths → 2/4 = 4 eighths; 2/8 stops at 2 eighths → bigger bottom number → smaller pieces → with the same top, 2/8 is shorter

say.hi: Ek 1/4 do 1/8 ke barabar hai, isliye sankhya rekha par 2/4 utna hi hai jitna 4/8, aur 2/8 usse kaafi pehle hai. Upar ka number same ho, toh jiska neeche ka number bada, woh bhinn chhota hai.
say.en: One 1/4 equals two 1/8, so on the number line 2/4 is as much as 4/8, and 2/8 is well before it. With the same top number, the fraction with the bigger bottom number is smaller.

simpler.hi: Ek 1/4 do 1/8 ke barabar hai, toh 2/4 utna hai jitna 4/8. 2/8 usse chhota hai.
simpler.en: One 1/4 equals two 1/8, so 2/4 is as much as 4/8. 2/8 is smaller than that.

why.en: both have 3 parts, and a quarter is bigger than a seventh, so 3/4 is longer than 3/7

simpler.hi: Dono mein 3 hisse liye. 4 hisson wala hissa 7 hisson wale hisse se bada hai.
simpler.en: Both take 3 parts. A part out of 4 is bigger than a part out of 7.

remediation.move: two same-size bars with the missing piece of each named: 9/10 is missing 1/10, a bigger gap; 11/12 is missing 1/12, a smaller gap → compare the size of the missing pieces, not their number → 1/12 < 1/10 → 11/12 is missing less → 11/12 bigger

simpler.hi: 9/10 mein 1/10 kam hai, aur 11/12 mein 1/12 kam hai. 1/12 chhota gap hai, isliye 11/12 bada hai.
simpler.en: 9/10 is missing 1/10, and 11/12 is missing 1/12. 1/12 is the smaller gap, so 11/12 is bigger.
